# Sketchi

Sketchi turns a plain-language prompt into a clean, editable diagram, brand
logos included. It is usable by people in the browser and by software agents
over MCP. Source is MIT-licensed at https://github.com/shpitdev/sketchi.

## Surfaces

https://sketchi.app/ — what Sketchi is, docs, and agent setup.
https://playground.sketchi.app/ — describe a diagram, refine it in chat, then
view, edit, or download it.
https://icons.sketchi.app/ — public SVG icon library with its own HTTP API.
See https://icons.sketchi.app/llms.txt for the icon endpoints.

## Agents

Connect a Streamable HTTP MCP client to https://playground.sketchi.app/mcp.
The server is named sketchi-code-mode and exposes three tools:

- docs: how to drive Sketchi, including the diagram spec shape.
- search: look up Sketchi API surface before writing a call.
- execute: run Sketchi code mode, which builds flowcharts, mindmaps, and
  sequence diagrams, fetches artifacts, and applies diagram patches.

Per-agent setup instructions live at https://sketchi.app/agents, with pages for
Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and Antigravity.

## Docs

https://sketchi.app/docs — how generation works, supported diagram types, and
the open-source layout.
